decisions.statement: An account here covers one item.
An account names every rule the item met rather than the rule that took the item.
A row of the walk is one line.
A tab parts one field of a row from the next.
A field the walk names but carries nothing for is written as the empty string.
The junk the game holds and the junk the game would allow are both written.
A junk field the capture never recorded is written `not captured`.
An item resolved to sell that the game will not let be marked junk is named at the foot.
The rows keep the order the rules were met in.
A sell-through rate is worked out here from the counts the pricing states.
A sell-through rate is worked out from no count the pricing left out.
A sell-through rate is trimmed where the sales outrun the amount counted.
A rule whose outcome could still turn is named again at the foot.
An item rule answering before the ordered rules is the row at index -1.
A walk holding that row is named at the foot as one no category rule was read for.

definition: the rules one item was walked through, written out as lines to read
